english.title: Fail to convey or assist in loading / unloading of luggage at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a Taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at Bristol Airport, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed when requested by a person hiring or seeking to hire the carriage, to

(A)_[give reasonable assistance in loading and unloading luggage]_
(B)_[convey a reasonable amount of luggage]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 7.9 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
